—Alright!
Is this finally the end of our meeting, then?

...Could it be that you're super worried about me?
I'm totally fine, you know? My body's grown bigger than before, after all.

Yeah! I want to try it... I want to run!
And then—... Hey, Mom.
Still, I believe in you.

(Will you watch me, and... make your eyes
sparkle all over again, just like that other day?)
Yes!! And with that, off I go!!

Then let's take a breather together.
...I'll brew some warm tea for us.

If I ask her to come, will big sis come?
Will she... watch me run again, I wonder?

I'm certain that one day, I'll definitely reach that dreamlike, breathtaking view.
I truly believe it.

......Hehe. Is that a bit bold for a pre-debut girl's dream?
You've got that look on your face.

A strong, dazzling, glorious scene of victory.
That's the dream I'm aiming for.

Always, for such a long time.
...The one who stayed by my side ever since I was very small.
Huh?
(Ah... there it is again.)

(I ended up thinking of you as... nothing more than
that same kind, gentle "big sister," but...)

Ah, big bro! Waah... You're soaking wet...!?
Are you okay? Did you... search all over for me...?
(That's not it, is it. You've already become a Trainer.)
"Yeah. We'll do it too...!!"

You went for a run yesterday too, after all... Stress is probably accumulating on your bones,
so let's focus mainly on the woodchip course with higher cushioning—

With those eyes looking straight at me, with that dazzling shine.
You're the person who always gave my legs the power to become invincible.
...Yes, the person I made that very, very precious promise with.
(...You really did, didn't you? Right here like this.)

And so... that wraps up our meeting agenda, right?
If you'd like, why don't we take a breather together? I'll make some tea.

Clutching an umbrella meant for me, getting completely drenched.
Even so, you were the person who always came for a crybaby, clingy girl like me.

We talked about wanting to start with a lighter intensity, right?
In that case... around an 18-second-per-furlong pace, maybe?

............Yup.
Understood, Trainer!

(Just... for a moment, I thought of you as the
same sweet, gentle older sibling from back then, but...)

So today, training on the woodchip course
was our main focus... right?

Of course, I have my own spectacular view that I want to reach!
Though it isn't completely concrete yet.
A "spectacular view that reaches everyone," I suppose.
(Her face is so tense.)

Huh, that's pretty gentle...! 
The woodchip course is easy on the legs too, so—

It's true that Spe-san's "Japan Cup" is what I admired, but
I'm not Spe-san. I can't create the exact same sight.

I want to become an Umamusume who can kindle... 
such strong, powerful expectations in everyone's hearts.
I've never doubted this feeling... not even once.

If I ask you to come, will you come? 
Will you... watch me run again?

Ah! Whoa... you're soaking wet...!?
Are you okay? Did you... spend all that time looking for me...?
"Yeah. Us too...!!"
"What kind of spectacular view do we want to aim for?", huh...

I see... So the outer perimeter course I usually run on
had that many hard-packed spots, huh?

—And that's our plan shared up until the day of the meet!
I'll give it my all starting tomorrow, Trainer!

Carrying the hopes and dreams of as many people as possible on my back.
Reaching it together with as many people as I can—

That's why I want to run in a way that touches everyone's hearts.
The kind that enchants them at first glance and makes them want to support me forever.
"Someday, without fail, let's reach a spectacular view like that."
Ugh, uuuugh... I hate the rain... *sniffle*...!
...Right. Someday, without fail, us too—!

...So, there's a race next month for kids up through lower elementary grades.
What do you think? ...Would you like to enter?

Hah, hah, hah... phew!
Done with the 16-second pace...! Pheeew...

Phew, alright...! 
That should do it for the warmup, right?
